'''Clue scroll (beginner)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 712
|text = The cryptic reveals who to speak to:<br><br>In a village of barbarians, I am the one who guards the village from up high.
|notes = Talk to [[Hunding]] atop the tower on the east side of [[Barbarian Village]].
|map = {{Map|3097,3429|mtype=pin|plane=2|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Skull sceptre (i)]] teleport.
*[[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]].
*[[Combat bracelet]] teleport to [[Edgeville Monastery]].
*[[Lassar Teleport]] and run south-east down the mountain.
*[[Chronicle]] and run north-west and then across the bridge over [[River Lum]].
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run west.
*[[Draynor Manor Teleport]] and run north around the fence of [[Draynor Manor]].
